hero.title: JOIDY
hero.subtitle: Private. Self-hosted. Your knowledge, your rules.

whatIs.title: What is Joidy?
whatIs.description: A private, self-hosted PKM system that turns notes into XP, an evolving plant, and a living knowledge graph — on your hardware, under your control.

pillars.title: Notes → XP
pillars.desc: Every note, edit, and connection generates experience points. Your knowledge becomes a game.

pillars.title: 100% Private
pillars.desc: Self-hosted on your machine. Zero cloud, zero tracking. Your data never leaves your network.

pillars.title: Living Graph
pillars.desc: Automatic connections between notes, tags, and skills. Discover relationships you never knew existed.

problem.title: The Problem
before: Scattered notes with zero connections between them
No motivation to maintain the writing habit
No visibility into your own learning progress
Your data trapped in proprietary clouds
after: Every note automatically linked, classified, searchable by meaning
XP, streaks, and plant evolution make note-taking a daily habit
Real-time graph shows what you know and what you don't
Your data stays on your machine. 100% yours, 100% private.

privacy.title: Privacy & Self-Hosting
privacy.description: Your knowledge is the most valuable thing you own. It should not live on someone else's server.

points.title: Your Data, Your Hardware
points.desc: Joidy runs entirely on your machine via Docker Compose. No cloud dependency, no third party.

points.title: Zero Telemetry
points.desc: No analytics, no tracking, no phone-home. What you write is what stays.

points.title: Local AI, Optional Cloud
points.desc: Use Ollama for fully local AI. No API key required. Cloud AI (Gemini, OpenAI) only if you choose.

points.title: SQLite on Your Disk
points.desc: A single portable file with vector search. Copy, version, encrypt — your database is yours to control.

steps.label: Obsidian Vault
steps.desc: The watcher detects changes in your .md files

steps.label: Worker
steps.desc: Imports the note and sends it to the API

steps.label: API
steps.desc: Awards XP, updates the skill tree and tag graph

steps.label: AI Service
steps.desc: Generates embeddings, classifies tags, enables semantic search

items.title: Gamification
items.desc: XP events, streaks, evolving plant (seed → tree). Every note levels you up.
items.highlight: No other PKM turns knowledge into growth

items.title: Knowledge Graph
items.desc: Tag co-occurrence visualization revealing hidden connections across your vault.
items.highlight: Connections no other tool shows you

items.title: Skill Tree
items.desc: Auto-generated from your tags. Watch your expertise grow and branch as you write.
items.highlight: Skills that evolve in real time

items.title: Semantic Search
items.desc: Vector search with sqlite-vec. Find notes by meaning, not just keywords.
items.highlight: Search by meaning, not by keyword

items.title: AI Classification
items.desc: Tags suggested by Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, or fully local with Ollama.
items.highlight: Your AI, your rules, your hardware

items.title: Cross-Connections
items.desc: Joidy automatically links related notes across your entire vault.
items.highlight: Automatic links between any two notes

items.title: Goals & Objectives
items.desc: Goal tracking with failure modes: rollover, snowball, daily reset.
items.highlight: Goals that adapt to your rhythm

items.title: Custom Streaks
items.desc: Configurable streaks for anything: read, meditate, gym, code.

items.title: Obsidian Sync
items.desc: Bidirectional sync. If you have a vault, Joidy enhances it.

items.title: Pomodoro Timer
items.desc: Built-in timer connected to your XP and streak system.

audience.title: Who Is It For?

items.title: Privacy-Conscious Users
items.desc: People who refuse to trade their knowledge for free cloud services.

items.title: Knowledge Workers
items.desc: Professionals managing large volumes of interconnected information.

items.title: Developers
items.desc: Who want an open-source, self-hosted PKM they can trust and extend.

items.title: Researchers & Students
items.desc: Who need to connect ideas across disciplines and uncover hidden relationships.
